Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ACTION: Fire an artillery attack at the target area for 10–50 damage per location on units within the blast radius. Has [NumberOfUses] uses per mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 操作：向目标区域发动炮击，对爆炸范围内的单位每个部位造成10–50点伤害。每次任务可使用[NumberOfUses]次。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ACTION: Fire an artillery attack at the target area for 10–50 damage per location on units within the blast radius. Has [NumberOfUses] uses per mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 操作：向目标区域发动炮击，对爆炸范围内的单位每个部位造成10–50点伤害。每次任务可使用[NumberOfUses]次。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Never trust a pirate. I've got a bad feeling about this, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 永远别信海盗。我有种不祥的预感，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it, Commander. We may have a rare opportunity to bring this pursuit to a close. I have negotiated a duel with the leader of the opposing force versus a combined unit from us both.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这一下了，指挥官。我们可能有一个难得的机会把这场追击画上句号。我已谈妥一场决斗：对方部队的领袖对上我们从双方各出一支组成的联合单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get Ready, She may try anything!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 准备好，她什么都干得出来！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This has been an interesting ride Commander. I wonder how this duel will play out?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一路可真够精彩的，指挥官。我很好奇这场决斗会怎么打？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It seems Morgan Kell has arrived on planet. He has challenged us to a trial of combat. We have the advantage. His entire force endured a high G burn from the jump point to get here so fast, so we will be fresh for battle. After we win, it will buy us the time I need to complete my plan.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来摩根·凯尔已经抵达行星。他向我们发起了战斗试炼的挑战。我们占据优势。他的全部部队从跳跃点一路承受高G加速才这么快赶到，所以我们会是精力充沛的一方。等我们赢了，就能为我争取到完成计划所需的时间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kell is a fool to challenge me. Don't screw up. Just make sure we win this and all will be worth your time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凯尔挑战我简直是愚蠢。别搞砸了。只要确保我们赢下这场，你花的时间就都值了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I will mark a possible ambush spot just in case.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以防万一，我会标记一处可能的伏击点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Expect Some of the Mercs to be less than honest.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 预料部分佣兵不会那么诚实。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You have been invited to a Divisional Round in the 'Gladiator Challange'. The opponent should be ready for you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已被邀请参加"角斗士挑战赛"的分区轮。对手应该已经准备好迎战你了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It is time to test your skills Mercenary!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是时候检验你的本领了，佣兵！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I am getting odd IFF readings from the planet, Commander. It looks like they have been... altered.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我从那颗行星上收到古怪的敌我识别读数。看起来它们被……改动过。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The forces protecting this planet have departed and a local militia has sprouted up in its place. The militia are fighting a losing battle against some especially well-equipped pirates, with no connections to any other group you've encountered. Your assistance in this sensitive matter is requested.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护这颗行星的部队已经撤离，取而代之的是一支当地民兵。那支民兵正与一些装备特别精良的海盗打一场必败之仗，那些海盗与你此前遭遇过的任何团体都没有关联。请你协助处理这一敏感事务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, thank you for the assistance. Our oppposition consists of pirates with high-end equipment and we are struggling.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，感谢你的协助。我们的对手是装备高端武器的海盗，我们打得很吃力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait, the local government Milita are Clan Wolf forces? This is Inner Sphere space. I am still trying to wrap my head around this one Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等等，当地政府的民兵是狼族部队？这里是内天体空间。指挥官，我到现在还没想明白这件事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These 'Militia' as they call themselves are freeborn Clan Wolf warriors. They don't belong in the inner sphere, and I am trying to drive them out. Break through their front lines then we will take down their base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些自称"民兵"的人是狼族氏族的自由出生者战士。他们不属于内天体，而我在试图把他们赶出去。突破他们的前线，然后我们就拿下他们的基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You will see for yourself. Up ahead should be a second line unit or better Touman.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你会亲眼看到的。前方应该是二等部队或更好的图曼。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Time to kick the Clan Pups off this ball of rock. Engage their base and clear out any remaining Touman.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该把那些部族崽子从这块石头上踢下去了。攻击他们的基地，清掉任何残留部队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pacify the Area around the Facility
[GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we can kick Clan Pup hard enough here it will break their ability to resist and I can finish driving them off of this world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们能在这里狠狠踢小狗族一脚，就能打断他们的抵抗能力，我就能把他们彻底赶出这颗行星。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, looks like we're going to stop a disaster today instead of starting one, for a change.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，看来今天我们是要阻止一场灾难，而不是引发一场，算是换换花样。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Things are going well. It seems Kell has lured the Corsair out for single battle. However, I have come upon information this was not her real goal. We discovered there is a nuclear warhead device being set up in the potential area of the duel. We will need you to deploy to draw off any defenders while we attempt to gain access and disarm the device. Expect heavy resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 事情进展顺利。看来凯尔已经把海盗引出来进行单挑了。不过我查到情报，说这并不是她真正的目的。我们发现决斗可能发生的区域里正被安放一件核弹头装置。我们需要你部署出去引开任何守军，而我们尝试接近并拆除该装置。预期会遇到强烈抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's get in there and stop the Red Corsair's plan. Lord Commander has given us the coordinates of the nuclear device.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们进去，阻止红海盗的计划。领主指挥官已经把核装置的坐标给了我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Now we are being ambushed by Clan Wolf. How can this day get any worse? I need you to head out and defend our east flank, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 现在我们又遭到狼族伏击。这一天还能更糟吗？我需要你出去防守我们的东翼，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！
我们正在接收多个接触信号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have our work cut out for us on this one. We have to make sure these guys stay safe so they can get back in the fight and help us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一票我们得下大功夫。我们必须确保这些人安全无余，好让他们能重新投入战斗并帮助我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad you're still with us. Since setting up this outpost we have been constantly harassed by the Red Corsair and her pirate goons. They must be making a tidy profit since she can afford some seriously advanced technlogy. Let's protect the base and give our personnel a chance to recuperate
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴你还活着。自打建起这座前哨，我们就不断遭到红海盗和她的海盗喽啰骚扰。他们一定赚得盆满钵满，因为她买得起一些相当先进的技术。让我们守住基地，给手下人一个喘息的机会

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend ALL Target Buildings from Destruction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护所有目标建筑免遭摧毁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to the Base Defenses
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工程师装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把他们安全护送到发电机那里，我们就能激活那些炮塔来提升防御能力。祝好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we will need to buy a bit more time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们得多争取一点时间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base. However, they are off-line.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周围设有据点防御系统. 但目前处于离线状态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A chance to dish out some pain back to the enemy, always my favorite.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有机会把痛苦还给敌人，永远是我最喜欢的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We need you to search for and destroy any pirate stragglers, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们需要你搜寻并消灭任何落单的海盗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could get some revenge on these Solahma!... I mean Pirates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴我们能对这些索拉赫玛报一箭之仇！……我是说海盗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It definately feels like a festive engagement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这确实像是一场节日般的交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're under heavy assault from Kell's Hounds. I need you to take out the advancing forces while I prepare to meet with their leaders. We have almost made it to the goal. I am thrilled you decided to stick around. The party is going to be fun.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正遭到凯尔猎犬的猛烈攻击。我需要你在准备会见他们领袖时干掉那些推进的部队。我们几乎就要达成目标了。我很高兴你决定留下。这场派对会很有趣。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have enemy contact, I would recommend a solid firing line. Tactics should not be one of their strong suites.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 发现敌军接触，我建议排成稳固的射击线。战术应该不是他们的强项之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Annihilator is an extremely rare 'Mech that is essentially a mobile siege tower. It can kick out more damage than almost any other unit on the field. It's unbelievably slow, though, and poorly armored for its size. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者是一种极为稀有的机甲，本质上是一座可移动的攻城塔，能打出的伤害几乎超过战场上的任何其他单位。但它慢得难以置信，就体型而言装甲也很差。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Annihilator is an extremely rare 'Mech that is essentially a mobile siege tower. It can kick out more damage than almost any other unit on the field. It's unbelievably slow, though, and poorly armored for its size.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者是一种极为稀有的机甲，本质上是一座移动的攻城塔。它能比战场上几乎任何其他单位打出更多伤害。不过它慢得难以置信，就其体型而言装甲也很差。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Archer's 2S variant trades some of its long-range punch to become even deadlier when it gets up close, mounting SRMs to follow up what its LRMs have battered. Its heat management still poses a huge problem, though, so its pilots have to stay very wary of overheating. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手的2S变型牺牲了部分远程打击力，换来近身后的更强杀伤力——它加装的SRM能在LRM轰击之后继续追击。不过它的散热依然是一大难题，机师必须时刻警惕过热。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Archer's 2S variant trades some of its long-range punch to become even deadlier when it gets up close, mounting SRMs to follow up what its LRMs have battered. Its heat management still poses a huge problem, though, so its pilots have to stay very wary of overheating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓手的2S改型牺牲部分远程打击力，以便在近身时更加致命，加装SRM来跟进其LRM已经打坏的部位。不过它的热量管理仍是巨大问题，所以其飞行员必须非常警惕过热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The well-known Archer is the epitome of the \"missile boat\" concept. It is commonly found hurling deadly swarms of LRMs at targets from behind the safety of a hill. It's not too shabby in closer-range fights, either. Its only real weakness is terrible heat management. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 广为人知的弓手是“导弹母舰”概念的典范，常被发现躲在山头后方，向目标倾泻致命的LRM弹群。它在较近距离的交战中也不算差。唯一真正的弱点是糟糕的热量管理。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The well-known Archer is the epitome of the \"missile boat\" concept. It is commonly found hurling deadly swarms of LRMs at targets from behind the safety of a hill. It's not too shabby in closer-range fights, either. Its only real weakness is terrible heat management.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 著名的弓手是"导弹艇"概念的典范。它常被发现躲在土丘的安全后方，向目标抛掷致命的LRM弹群。在近距离战斗中它也不差。它唯一真正的弱点是糟糕透顶的热量管理。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas 是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人眼花缭乱的各种武器。它还以通常搭载尽可能多的装甲而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存下来。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of the mysterious Red Corsair started life as a Royal BLR-1Gbc model, but was refitted with Clan-tech weaponry and structural components. A single ER PPC is located in each arm, with a Large Pulse Laser installed in the center torso, and all six of the medium lasers are upgraded to medium pulse lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks manage the heat generated by these weapons. To command her force, the Red Corsair's BattleMaster mounted a Command Console in the head. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder was first built by General Motors in 2612 for use as an attack and direct fire support BattleMech. The first 'Mech to diverge from the traditional humanoid shape of previous machines, the Marauder was one of the most well-known 'Mechs in existence and originally meant to usher in a new generation of 'Mechs. Unfortunately, with the fall of the Star League, this new generation never quite materialized. On its own merits though, the Marauder was a devastatingly powerful 'Mech, outclassed only by larger machines like the Stalker and BattleMaster. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者最初由通用汽车公司于2612年制造，用作攻击与直射火力支援战斗机甲。作为首款摆脱以往人形机甲传统造型的机甲，掠夺者是有史以来最负盛名的机甲之一，最初被寄望于开启机甲的新一代。遗憾的是，随着星际联盟的覆灭，这一代新机甲终究未能真正成形。不过就自身实力而言，掠夺者是一台极具毁灭性的强力机甲，唯有潜行者、战斗大师等更大型的机体才能压过它一头。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Darius calls you to the bridge. \"My contacts came through, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I've got a lead on the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],Dobrev]].\" A grainy image fills the viewscreen. \"What you're looking at is a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBaumannGroup],Baumann Group]] distribution center on [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreIndependence],Independence]]. Every scrap of exotic contraband that's been turning up on the black market has gone through this site.\" Sumire nods thoughtfully. \"Sounds good, XO. I'll mark it on the star map. When we're ready to check it out, just let me know.\" \"One other thing, Commander.\" Darius pulls up a dossier on the viewscreen. \"For 50,000 C-Bills, I can arrange for a portion of Baumann's security team to call in sick on the day of our arrival. Could save us some trouble when we follow up on this.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达里乌斯把你叫到舰桥。"我的联系人办成了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我拿到了关于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],多布雷夫]]的线索。"一张颗粒感很重的图像占满了显示屏。"你看到的是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBaumannGroup],鲍曼集团]]在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreIndependence],独立星]]上的一个配送中心。所有出现在黑市上的异域违禁品，都是从这里流出去的。" 苏米蕾若有所思地点点头。"听起来不错，执行官。我会把它标在星图上。等我们准备去查看时，告诉我一声就行。" "还有一件事，指挥官。"达里乌斯在显示屏上调出一份档案。"给我5万C币，我可以安排鲍曼的部分安保人员在我们抵达那天请病假。这也许能让我们后续追查时省点麻烦。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Authorize Darius to arrange the bribe.
high spirits, defend your decision, one-on-one
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 情绪高涨，坚持你的决定，一对一

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yang calls you to the MechLab, where you find him standing in the shadow of an enormous ferro-aluminum crate. \"I don't think that the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBountyHunter],Bounty Hunter]] realized what he was giving us, Boss. What we've got is one third of a mothballed assault 'Mech—mostly the guts, so it doesn't look like much to the untrained eye. But what I can tell you is that this 'Mech is strange. Never seen anything quite like it.\" Farah raises her hand. \"And I think I have a lead on the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],Dobrev]]. An old colleague of mine contacted me about a group of patients at the hospital she administrates. They were suffering from what appeared to be [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]-induced injuries. I think it's worth investigating.\" Sumire rubs her temples. \"I can't believe I'm saying this, but I've got one, too. A [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreJumpShip],JumpShip]] operator I used to hang with has been running his mouth about a big job he just did for Notker Baumann. Want me to follow up?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杨把你叫到机甲实验室，你看见他站在一只巨大的铁铝合金箱子的阴影里。"我觉得[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBountyHunter],赏金猎人]]没意识到他给了我们什么，老大。我们拿到的是三分之一的封存突击机甲——大部分是内脏，所以在没受过训练的人眼里看着不起眼。但我能告诉你的是，这台机甲很怪。我从没见过类似的东西。" 法拉举起手。"而我想我有一条关于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],多布雷夫]]的线索。我的一位老同事联系我，说她主管的医院里有一群病人。他们遭受的似乎是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],误跳]]造成的损伤。我觉得值得调查。" 苏米蕾揉着太阳穴。"我简直不敢相信我会这么说，但我也有条线索。一个以前跟我混在一起的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreJumpShip],跃迁舰]]操作员一直在吹嘘他刚为诺特克·鲍曼做的一桩大活。要我去跟进吗？"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: high spirits, defend your decision, one-on-one
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 情绪高涨，坚持你的决定，一对一
情绪高涨，粉丝们表示赞同
不诚实的选项，一对一决斗

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Farah calls you to the Argo's Command Center, where you find the viewscreen overflowing with grainy Holo images and dossiers. \"Multiple sources confirm that an unknown spacecraft crashed into a saltwater lake on [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore],Mantharaka]] about a month ago. Her surviving crew was medevaced to an orbiting station, where they were all found to have suffered misjump-induced injuries.\" \"That's the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],Dobrev]]!\" Farah pumps her fist, her smile radiant with triumph. \"It has to be!\" Darius nods. \"Yes, and that was the good news. The bad news is, we're not the only company on the derelict's trail. The [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackWidow],Black Widow]] has been carving a bloody trail across the Frontier, burning out black market sites on over a dozen worlds. And I have reliable information that she's moving toward Mantharaka.\" Sumire shakes her head. \"If we fight the Black Widow, she's gonna end us. This is a bad idea, Commander.\" Farah shrugs. \"So we move fast. If we recover the Dobrev's navigation logs before she gets there, we won't even need to fight.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 法拉把你叫到阿戈号的指挥中心，那里显示屏上满是颗粒感强烈的全息影像与档案。"多个来源确认，约一个月前有一艘不明航天器坠入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore],曼塔拉卡]]的一处咸水湖。其幸存的船员被医疗后送到一座轨道站，在那里发现他们全都遭受了误跳造成的损伤。" "那就是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],多布雷夫]]！"法拉挥拳庆祝，笑容因胜利而灿烂。"一定是它！" 达里乌斯点点头。"是的，那是好消息。坏消息是，我们不是唯一在追这艘废船的。[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackWidow],黑寡妇]]在边疆一路血洗，烧毁了十几个世界的黑市据点。而我有可靠情报说她正朝曼塔拉卡移动。" 苏米蕾摇头。"如果跟黑寡妇打，她会把我们了结掉。这是个坏主意，指挥官。" 法拉耸耸肩。"那我们就快点行动。如果在她到那儿之前取回多布雷夫的导航日志，我们根本不用打。"

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。我有一项重要任务给你，一次在核心边疆最边缘的救援行动。到塔拉戈纳来见我，我会告诉你细节。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is exciting, Commander—our first real lead in the hunt for the Dobrev! If we find that derelict, we may find the answer to the single greatest mystery of our age!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这太令人兴奋了，指挥官——我们在追猎多布雷夫上得到了第一条真正的线索！如果我们找到那艘废船，也许就能找到我们这个时代最大谜团的答案！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our intel was right, Commander. Surface scans show that the Dobrev is moored at a makeshift spaceport near Appian's southern pole. We can take it, but we'll need to move fast.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的情报没错，指挥官。地表扫描显示多布雷夫停靠在阿皮亚南极附近的一处临时太空港。我们能拿下它，但必须行动迅速。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a point of no return, Commander. When you pull the trigger on this drop, you may well be committing us to a confrontation with the Black Widow. We’d better be ready.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是不归路，指挥官。当你为这次投放扣下扳机时，你很可能就是把我们推入与黑寡妇的正面冲突。我们最好准备好。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我还是不敢相信我们连在跟谁打都不知道。我想事情就是这样吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to ISF intelligence, Captain Gaku Magorian is being held prisoner in one of a dozen safe houses within the boundaries of Alamedo Province. Obviously, we can't rely on trial and error to find him, so we're going to have to narrow down the list. Our unidentified syndicate is known to maintain a forward base in this AO. Capture it so that Dr. Murad can scour the OpFor's mainframe for confirmation of Captain Magorian's whereabouts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据ISF情报，学·马戈里安上尉被关押在阿拉梅多省边界内十几处安全屋中的某一处。显然，我们不能靠试错来找他，所以必须缩小范围。我们那个身份不明的辛迪加已知在此行动区域维持着一处前沿基地。夺取它，好让穆拉德博士能在敌军主机里搜寻确认马戈里安上尉下落的资料。
占领未确认的犯罪集团基地.
消灭犯罪集团的增援部队
消灭未确认犯罪集团的防御力量.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out as Combat Drones Counterattack
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在战斗无人车的反击中幸存下来.
侦察未确认的犯罪集团基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Careful, Boss. The syndicate just brought a bunch of turrets online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心，老板. 犯罪集团刚刚上线了一堆炮台.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I reached out to you for this job because I believed that your company was up to the task. I can see now that I was mistaken.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我找你来做这份工作是因为我相信你的公司能胜任这项任务. 现在我明白我错了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, Commander. Our unidentified crime syndicate's forward base should lie somewhere up ahead. Stick your neck out far enough and you're bound to find it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，指挥官。我们那个身份不明的犯罪辛迪加的前沿基地应该就在前方某处。把头探得够远，你一定能找到它。
主目标 ATTN 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's hope this is the last hoop we need to jump through before finding this guy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 但愿这是我们找到这家伙之前需要跳过的最后一个圈。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Zeta Lance moved Captain Magorian out of Alamedo Province two days ago. They're holding him in a bunker somewhere under the ruins of New Vulci, a city that fell victim to a nuclear accident in 2977. Engage Zeta Lance and destroy their 'Mechs. When you're finished, I'll scour their combat computers for the bunker's coordinates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 泽塔分队两天前把马戈里安上尉转移出了阿拉梅多省。他们把他关在新武尔奇废墟地下的某处掩体里——那座城市在2977年毁于一场核事故。交战并摧毁泽塔分队的机甲。等你们完事，我会翻查他们的战斗计算机，找出掩体的坐标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort the Bounty Hunters to their evac point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送赏金猎人到撤离点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I reached out to you for this job because I believed that your company was up to the task. I can see now that I was mistaken.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我找你来做这份工作是因为我相信你的公司能胜任这项任务. 现在我明白我错了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Who launched them? Does the Baumann Group have a DropShip in orbit?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 谁发射的? 鲍曼集团在轨道上有空投艇吗?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You think it has something to do with the derelict?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你觉得这跟那艘废弃飞船有关?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Zeta Lance should be somewhere just ahead of you, Commander. They're…

Huh. That's strange.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
泽塔分队应该就在你前方某处，指挥官。他们……

嗯。这很奇怪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离
隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get ready, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Our 'Mechs are about to soak up a lot of incoming fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 准备好，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们的机甲即将承受大量来袭火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm dropping you at the Baumann Group's armory, Commander. Hit it hard enough, and the prison's garrison should come running, clearing the way for the Moderbjörn to rescue Captain Magorian with its drones.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我把你投放在鲍曼集团的军械库，指挥官。打得够狠，监狱的守备队就该赶过来了，从而为莫德比约恩用无人机营救马戈里安上尉清出道路。
摧毁鲍曼集团的战斗机甲.
消灭鲍曼集团的增援部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Baumann Group armory and all defending units
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁鲍曼集团的军械库并消灭所有防御者.
摧毁鲍曼集团的军械库.
隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Already, huh? These hired guns must be starving for action. You with us, M-B?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 已经来了，嗯? 这些雇佣兵肯定是饿疯了，急着想干架. 我们可以指望你，对吧，M-B?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mission accomplished, Commander. Assuming the Moderbjörn has done its part, our job here should be done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务完成，指挥官. 既然“熊妈妈”已达成目标，我们在此地的任务应该结束了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our distraction is already working, Commander. I'm picking up a lance of heavy 'Mechs between us and the armory, and they don't look friendly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的牵制已经起效了，指挥官。我在我们与军械库之间侦测到一支重型机甲分队，看起来不太友好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What about Baumann? Is his JumpShip still up there?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鲍曼呢? 他的跃迁舰还在现场吗?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Retrieve the VIP and Extract Safely
The objective for the player to retrieve the primary rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家接回主要救援目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the primary target alive. Player will fail if it is destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带次要目标的单位存活。玩家可能在此目标上失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary and optional objective to secure the second rescue target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要且可选的目标：确保第二个救援目标安全。
未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If the Moderbjörn holds up its end, we should be golden. Our lance will be in trouble if it doesn't.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果莫德比约恩能撑住它那一头，我们就稳了。如果不能，我们的分队就会有麻烦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Captain Magorian is being held in a subterranean bunker attached to a complex just ahead of us. We're going to sneak a scout lance in, rescue the captain, and bug out. If all goes according to plan, the Moderbjörn's combat drones will distract the bunker's garrison and keep it out of our hair for the duration of the operation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马戈里安上尉被关押在我们前方一处建筑群附属的地下掩体里。我们要偷偷潜入一支侦察分队，救出上尉，然后撤出。如果一切按计划进行，莫德比约恩的战斗无人机将牵制掩体的守军，让它在整个行动期间不碍我们的事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ensure Secondary Asset Recovery unit survives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保次要资产回收单位存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recover Captain Magorian by Securing the Designated Area
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 通过控制指定区域来营救马格里安船长.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Retrieve Captain Gaku Magorian and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 找到贺久·马格里安船长并安全撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The asset has been recovered, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset has been recovered, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Captain Magorian's safe house is just ahead of you, Commander. Defenses should be light. That said, there'll probably be some armed resistance, so be ready to brush it aside.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马戈里安上尉的安全屋就在你前方，指挥官。防御应该不重。话虽如此，大概还是会有些武装抵抗，所以准备好把它扫开。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What about Baumann? Is his JumpShip still up there?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鲍曼呢? 他的跃迁舰还在现场吗?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Baumann Group's made a lot of money off of the Dobrev. We're gonna find out where they took it—and get a piece of the profits for ourselves while we're at it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鲍曼集团靠多布雷夫赚了大钱。我们要查出他们把它带到哪儿去了——顺便给自己分一份利润。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Like I said, the Baumann Group's distribution center is heavily defended, so we're gonna approach this as a two-stage operation. For this first stage, you're going to descend at the outermost edge of the OpFor's territory and engage their patrolling cavalry. Take out as many vehicles and 'Mechs as you can to clear the way for an assault on the distribution center.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如我所说，鲍曼集团的分销中心防御严密，所以这次行动要分两阶段。第一阶段，你将在敌方领土最外缘降落，并交上其巡逻骑兵。尽可能多地消灭车辆与机甲，为攻打分销中心清出道路。
消灭鲍曼集团的骑兵部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Baumann Group Security Team
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁鲍曼集团的安保部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to our intel, the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBaumannGroup],Baumann Group]]'s cavalry lance should be patrolling through this AO. Get in there, hit 'em hard, and wipe 'em out. When the cavalry lance is on ice, you'll be clear to advance on Baumann's distribution center.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据我们的情报，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBaumannGroup],鲍曼集团]]的骑兵分队应该正在这一行动区域巡逻。进去，狠狠打击，把他们清掉。等骑兵分队上了冰，你就可以放心向鲍曼的配送中心推进。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。
老天！指挥官，我们有“客人”了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we turn tail and run, the Bounty Hunter will probably shoot us in the ass on our way out the door. The man has a reputation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 要是我们掉头逃跑，赏金猎人可能会直接朝我们开枪. 这个人因此而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So much for our cautious approach. Can you get us over there now, Meyer?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 谨慎行动的计划泡汤了！现在能带我们赶过去吗，梅耶尔?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thanks for the heads-up, I guess?
That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're almost there, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Just one more push and the derelict is ours.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们快到了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。再推进一步，那艘废船就是我们的了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As per our earlier discussion, I'm going to drop you right on top of a Baumann Group security outpost some 20 klicks from the Dobrev's spaceport. You're going to have to capture the site and clear out its defenses. When the job's done, the Moderbjörn will use the complex's computers to drop the spaceport's defenses and remotely engage the Dobrev's docking clamps. I'd expect the OpFor's defenses to run heavy on this one, so I'd advise building your lance accordingly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 按照我们先前讨论的，我会把你直接投放在鲍曼集团一处安保前哨的头顶，那里距离多布雷夫的太空港约20公里。你得夺取该地点并清掉其防御。任务完成后，莫德比约恩会用该建筑群的计算机解除太空港的防御，并远程启动多布雷夫的对接钳。我预计这次敌方防御会很厚，所以建议你相应组建分队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Advance on the Baumann Group Security Complex
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻击鲍曼集团的安全综合体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture the Baumann Group Security Complex
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夺取鲍曼集团的安保基地.
消灭鲍曼集团的防御力量.
消灭鲍曼集团增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out as Baumann Group Mercenaries Counter Attack
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在鲍曼集团雇佣兵的反击中幸存下来.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pacify the Baumann Group Security Complex Base
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 平定鲍曼集团的安保基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Okay, Commander, I've set our lance down just outside the Baumann Group's visual range.

Defenses will probably run on the heavy side, so I'd recommend approaching with caution.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
好，指挥官，我已把我们的分队降落在鲍曼集团视野范围之外。

防御大概会偏重型，所以我建议谨慎接近。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What is it, Meyer? Who do you have on the line?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 怎么了，梅耶尔? 你在和谁通话?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obviously, this deployment is gonna be a little fraught. It's on us to handle it anyway.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 显然，这次部署会有点惊险。无论如何都得由我们来处理。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nicely done, pal! You just pulled my feet out of the fire, big time!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，伙计！你刚刚把我从火坑里拉了出来，太及时了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dobrev is gone, but its crew left an undefined amount of valuable contraband behind at the spaceport. Unfortunately, the Black Widow wants to melt every scrap of that contraband to slag. The Moderbjörn will draw the Black Widow's attention away from our AO, which should buy Yang and me enough time to ransack the spaceport. We'll be relying on your lance to protect us from anyone else who might come along.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 多布雷夫已经不见了，但它的船员在太空港留下了数量不明的贵重违禁品。不幸的是，黑寡妇想把这些违禁品全部熔成矿渣。莫德比约恩会把黑寡妇的注意力引离我们的行动区域，这应该能给我和杨争取到足够时间洗劫太空港。我们将依靠你的分队保护我们免受任何其他来人干扰。
消灭黑寡妇公司的雇佣兵.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队
保护所有太空港支撑结构.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the Evacuated Spaceport from the Black Widow Company
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护已疏散的太空港，抵御黑寡妇公司的进攻.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
All right, Commander. I've just set you down in front of the Baumann Group's abandoned spaceport. Farah, Yang, and their team should already be inside.

Can you confirm that, Yang?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
好了，指挥官。我刚把你放在鲍曼集团废弃的太空港前。法拉、杨和他们的团队应该已经在里面了。

杨，你能确认吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators. We can boost our defensive capabilities with those turrets activated. Good luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送他们安全抵达发电机那里，一旦那些炮台启动，我们的防御能力就能大幅提升. 祝你好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base. However, they are offline.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周围设置了炮台. 不过目前处于离线状态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy of engineers eager to get at those defenses and bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个充满技术人员的盟军车队必须被护送到防御，以便他们可以被激活.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move fast, {COMMANDER.FirstName}! The Black Widow and the Bounty Hunter are on their way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快，{COMMANDER.FirstName}！黑寡妇和赏金猎人正在路上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've found the Dobrev, and this time, it's in no condition to run. Time is of the essence here, so we're going to deploy alongside the Moderbjörn's drones. Hit the Baumann Group fast, hit 'em hard, and wipe the AO clean. After we've taken the Dobrev, we'll discuss our next steps.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们找到多布雷夫了，而这一次，它没法再跑了。时间紧迫，所以我们将与莫德比约恩的无人机一同部署。快速打击鲍曼集团，狠狠打击，把行动区域清干净。等我们拿下多布雷夫，再讨论下一步。
所有“熊妈妈”无人车都必须存活
消灭鲍曼集团的雇佣兵.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Dead Star Devils Brawler Lance
Escort surviving combat drones to evac point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送任何剩余的战斗无人车到撤离点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This entire AO is crawling with Baumann Group mercenaries, Commander. It looks like they're preparing to make a last stand.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 整个行动区域都爬满了鲍曼集团的雇佣兵，指挥官。看起来他们正准备做最后一搏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're up against legends. Again. But the hell with it, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's go make a legend of our own.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们又要对上传奇了。又是这样。但管他呢，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。咱们去创造属于我们自己的传奇。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it—the final confrontation between ourselves, the Black Widow, and the Bounty Hunter. Succeed in this, and the Moderbjörn will have all the time it needs to harvest the Dobrev's navigation logs. The secrets of the Star League lie within our grasp, Commander. I know we can do this, so let's get to it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这一下了——我们、黑寡妇与赏金猎人之间的最后对决。成功之后，莫德比约恩就会有充足的时间来提取多布雷夫的导航日志。星盟的秘密就在我们掌握之中，指挥官。我知道我们能做到，那就动手吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defeat the Black Widow and the Bounty Hunter
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 击败黑寡妇和赏金猎人.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Holy shit, we did it! We actually won!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天哪，我们做到了！我们真的赢了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I commend your bravery, Commander. But we both know how this is going to end.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我敬佩你的勇气，指挥官. 但我们都知道，这将如何结束.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If you want to put an asterisk by our victory, be my guest! I, for one, intend to celebrate!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果你想给我们的胜利加个双引号，请便. 至于我，当然要好好庆祝！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, here we are again. Facing off against a certified badass, with another on the way. And they're both spoiling for a fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，又来了。面对一个认证过的狠角色，还有一个正在路上。而他们两个都憋着要打一场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Annihilator is an extremely rare 'Mech that is essentially a mobile siege tower. It can kick out more damage than almost any other unit on the field. It's unbelievably slow, though, and poorly armored for its size. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者是一种极为稀有的机甲，本质上是一座可移动的攻城塔，能打出的伤害几乎超过战场上的任何其他单位。但它慢得难以置信，就体型而言装甲也很差。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Archer's 2S variant trades some of its long-range punch to become even deadlier when it gets up close, mounting SRMs to follow up what its LRMs have battered. Its heat management still poses a huge problem, though, so its pilots have to stay very wary of overheating. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手的2S变型牺牲了部分远程打击力，换来近身后的更强杀伤力——它加装的SRM能在LRM轰击之后继续追击。不过它的散热依然是一大难题，机师必须时刻警惕过热。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The well-known Archer is the epitome of the \"missile boat\" concept. It is commonly found hurling deadly swarms of LRMs at targets from behind the safety of a hill. It's not too shabby in closer-range fights, either. Its only real weakness is terrible heat management. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 广为人知的弓手是“导弹母舰”概念的典范，常被发现躲在山头后方，向目标倾泻致命的LRM弹群。它在较近距离的交战中也不算差。唯一真正的弱点是糟糕的热量管理。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas 是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人眼花缭乱的各种武器。它还以通常搭载尽可能多的装甲而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存下来。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The personal 'Mech of the mysterious Red Corsair started life as a Royal BLR-1Gbc model, but was refitted with Clan-tech weaponry and structural components. A single ER PPC is located in each arm, with a Large Pulse Laser installed in the center torso, and all six of the medium lasers are upgraded to medium pulse lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks manage the heat generated by these weapons. To command her force, the Red Corsair's BattleMaster mounted a Command Console in the head. Sixteen tons of standard armor protected an Endo Steel skeleton and an XL engine. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 神秘的“红海盗”（Red Corsair）的座机最初是皇家 BLR-1Gbc 型，但被改装上了部族科技武器与结构部件。每条手臂各装有一门增程粒子炮，中央躯干内装有一门大型脉冲激光，六门中型激光则全部升级为中型脉冲激光。二十一台双散热器负责处理这些武器产生的热量。为指挥她的部队，红海盗的战斗大师（BattleMaster）在头部装有一台指挥控制台。十六吨标准装甲保护着内骨架结构和 XL 引擎。 特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.21

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've never seen anything like this, Commander. This 'Mech oozes deadly grace and can obviously devastate anything in its path. It's otherworldly, but clearly influenced by Star League tech. It has a mounted artillery piece to boot, I wonder where it came from. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我从没见过这样的东西，指挥官。这台机甲散发着致命的优雅，显然能摧毁路上的一切。它非人间所有，却明显受星际联盟技术影响。它还装了一门火炮，我真想知道它从哪来。 特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Marauder was first built by General Motors in 2612 for use as an attack and direct fire support BattleMech. The first 'Mech to diverge from the traditional humanoid shape of previous machines, the Marauder was one of the most well-known 'Mechs in existence and originally meant to usher in a new generation of 'Mechs. Unfortunately, with the fall of the Star League, this new generation never quite materialized. On its own merits though, the Marauder was a devastatingly powerful 'Mech, outclassed only by larger machines like the Stalker and BattleMaster. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 掠夺者最初由通用汽车公司于2612年制造，用作攻击与直射火力支援战斗机甲。作为首款摆脱以往人形机甲传统造型的机甲，掠夺者是有史以来最负盛名的机甲之一，最初被寄望于开启机甲的新一代。遗憾的是，随着星际联盟的覆灭，这一代新机甲终究未能真正成形。不过就自身实力而言，掠夺者是一台极具毁灭性的强力机甲，唯有潜行者、战斗大师等更大型的机体才能压过它一头。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The RFL-3N Rifleman is as well known for its terrible armor as for its ability to hammer opponents from long range. It has only average speed and poor heat sinking ability, but if you can put it in the right position, it can rain death on anything it surveys. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: RFL-3N Rifleman 以装甲薄弱闻名，也以能从远距离猛击对手而闻名。它的速度平平，散热能力也很差，但只要你能把它摆到合适的位置，它就能让视野内的一切目标沐浴在死亡之雨中。 特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂
